title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.29
exact_target: If two monic polynomials have exactly the same zeros and their derivatives also have exactly the same zeros, must positive powers of the polynomials coincide?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2304029 (AMR-022-4029). CC BY 4.0.
